title: betula utilis var. jacquemontii
intro: Betula utilis var. jacquemontii, commonly known as White Birch, is a deciduous tree native to the Himalayan and Tibetan regions. The plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, inflammation, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of White Birch include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of White Birch also exhibit antioxidant and immunomodulatory activities, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
